title: Ann Arbor Farmers Market Saturday Market Regular Hours
Ann Arbor Sustainable Energy Utility Expanded Pilot Open House (income-eligible households)
venue: Ann Arbor District Library - Traverwood Branch
description:
The A2SEU is expanding service to income-eligible Ann Arbor households, citywide, including renters! Attend a drop-in session to learn what A2SEU solar and backup battery service could mean for you and your household. Please note, this pilot and open house are intended for residents who qualify for assistance program(s), such as Medicaid, the Michigan Energy Assistance Program (MEAP) or other. Stop by to ask questions and talk with an A2SEU staff member.


Three open houses - attend the one best for your schedule:
  • Sunday, Nov. 8, 10 a.m.–noon, Ann Arbor District Library, Downtown Branch, Whiffletree Room
  • Saturday, Nov. 14, 11 a.m.–1 p.m., Ann Arbor District Library, Malletts Creek Branch, Raingarden Room
  • Saturday, Nov. 21, 11 a.m.–1 p.m., Ann Arbor District Library, Traverwood Branch, Emerald Room
Additional ways to learn about the expanded pilot:
  • Watch the A2SEU Pilot video: a2seu.com/PilotVideo
  • See the pilot program flyer (PDF) for details about the A2SEU system, fees and more.
  • Complete the expanded pilot expression of interest form - commitment free - a2seu.com/PilotForm

title: Cinema & Sustainability Series: No Impact Man (with pre-screening Climate Cafe)
description:
In collaboration with Marquee Arts, OSI is sponsoring the return of the free Cinema & Sustainability film series, which explores sustainability, environmental stewardship, and the collective actions shaping a green future. The second film in the series, No Impact Man, will screen Thursday, December 3rd, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. at the Michigan Theater. Tickets can be reserved for free online. Please also consider joining us at 6pm before the screening to participate in a Climate Cafe discussion hosted by University of Michigan's Planet Blue.

The Cinema & Sustainability series will run through March, 2027.

title: Free Family Trivia Night
description:
Looking for a fun night of friendly competition? Gather your family and join us for Free Family Trivia at the Ann Arbor Senior Center. Questions range in difficulty for kids, teens, and adults, so everyone can participate. Teams may have up to eight people, and each participant must register in advance. Dec. 4 from 5–6:30 p.m. at the Ann Arbor Senior Center, 1320 Baldwin Ave. Participation is free, but preregistration is required. Space is limited.

title: Monthly Clothing Swap: Clothing Swap, Gift Swap, and Furoshiki Workshop
venue: Larcom City Hall, City Council Chambers, 2nd Floor
description:
Join our monthly A²ZERO clothing swaps on the third Thursday of each month! Swaps are an opportunity to refresh your wardrobe, without buying new. Swaps are also a chance to gift your gently used clothes to members of your community, without contributing to the 92 million tons of textile waste generated globally each year. These are completely free events.


​How it works: Each person can bring up to 10 items of clothing in good condition (no rips, holes, stains or unwashed items please unless you plan to mend them at the swap). Accessories such as bags, jewelry, and belts are also welcome. You can take clothing without bringing anything, or bring clothing without taking anything.


​We especially need:
  • ​Plus-sized clothing
  • ​Masc clothing
​Gift Swap: At this swap we'll also be accepting giftable items in great condition including:
  • ​Books
  • ​Holiday decorations/ornaments
  • ​Unused Candles
  • ​Journals, Notebooks & Stationary
  • ​Puzzles & Games
  • ​Toys
  • ​Jewelry & Accessories
  • ​Ceramics
  • ​Art Prints
  • ​Knick Knacks
​No:
  • ​Broken/missing pieces
  • ​Hazardous
  • ​Large items
  • ​Worn/tattered
​Skill Building Workshop:​Come learn furoshiki gift wrapping with upcycled clothing fabric!                             
Community Resource: ​All Hands Active will also be running their clothing repair clinic and participants can bring items with minor flaws to be mended and either swapped or kept.


​Join our monthly A²ZERO clothing swaps on the third Thursday of each month! Swaps are an opportunity to refresh your wardrobe, without buying new. title: Love a Park w/OSI
description:
Show some love to a city park! Join the City of Ann Arbor’s Office of Sustainability and Innovations and the Ann Arbor Parks Volunteer Program for a volunteer workday focused on caring for the park’s playground area.
During this event, volunteers may do a variety of projects, depending on the need of the park. 
Whether you’re a longtime volunteer or joining us for the first time, this is a great opportunity to spend time outdoors, connect with community members, and make a visible impact in a neighborhood park.
No prior experience is necessary—staff will provide all tools, supplies, training, and guidance throughout the event.
Come lend a hand, meet your community, and show your love for Ann Arbor Parks!
  •  Date: Friday, December 18, 2026
  •  Time: 3:00 – 5:00 p.m.
  •  Location: To be announced
What to wear and bring:
  • Closed-toe shoes
  • Weather-appropriate clothes that can get dusty or dirty
  • Reusable water bottle
  • We’ll provide gloves, tools, and instruction
What to expect:
  • Tasks may involve bending, kneeling, pulling weeds, or working close to the ground
  • Work will be outdoors and there may be limited shade
  • All minors must be accompanied by a guardian
